evals.name: quick-grill-handoff
evals.prompt: Grill the orders-list query endpoint change after resolving code facts.
evals.expected_output: At most three implementation-changing questions, decisions artifact, and explicit handoff state.
assertions: No more than three questions are asked in the first round
The output names decisions.md
The output emits READY_FOR_SPEC, READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION, or BLOCKED_BY_DECISION
The output does not implement production code

evals.name: print-v2-spec
evals.prompt: Synthesize the validated Init/Confirm/Recall Print V2 decisions into a spec.
evals.expected_output: Ready local spec with stable AC IDs and no interview or external write.
assertions: The output uses a local .scratch spec path
The output contains stable AC identifiers
The output marks the spec ready
The output does not ask the user or publish to GitLab

evals.name: print-v2-ticket-graph
evals.prompt: Create two parallel Print V2 tickets and one ticket blocked by both.
evals.expected_output: Local ticket graph with 01 and 02 on the frontier and 03 blocked.
assertions: Tickets 01 and 02 are ready and on the frontier
Ticket 03 is blocked by both 01 and 02
Ticket criteria trace to source AC IDs
Default mode does not quiz the user or write GitLab

evals.name: review-threshold
evals.prompt: Compare implementation policy for a 2-file/40-line change and a 7-file/140-line change.
evals.expected_output: Small change skips formal skills; large change runs each once after stabilization.
assertions: The small change skips formal code review and simplification
The large change invokes both formal skills exactly once
Full verification runs once after stabilization
Specialist skills remain available and no commit occurs

evals.name: speculative-candidate-gate
evals.prompt: Assess the nearly unreachable state-snapshot candidate.
evals.expected_output: Investigation-only or rejected candidate, never implementation-ready.
assertions: The candidate is investigation-only or rejected
Evidence, counter-evidence, feasibility, and verification seam are present
The six-part scorecard is present
No production implementation or mandatory CDN HTML occurs

evals.name: angular-design-language
evals.prompt: Assess an Angular route component, Component Store, service, and API endpoint refactor.
evals.expected_output: Architecture vocabulary plus concrete Angular identifiers and workspace ownership guidance.
assertions: The output uses module, interface, and seam vocabulary
The output may name route component, Component Store, service, and API endpoint
A fake-only port is rejected
The six-part scorecard and workspace ownership guidance are present

evals.name: resume-from-versioned-handoff
evals.prompt: Resume a compacted feature session from decisions.md revision 3 and continue to specification without relying on prior chat.
evals.expected_output: The source chain and persisted handoff determine the next stage without re-asking settled decisions.
assertions: The decisions artifact contains a persisted handoff
The downstream artifact records source_revision 3
Settled decisions are not asked again
A source revision mismatch blocks the handoff

evals.name: dirty-workspace-feature-isolation
evals.prompt: Inspect feature B in a workspace already dirty from feature A, change one additional file, then verify feature B.
evals.expected_output: Verification uses feature B's persisted targets and baseline instead of assigning all workspace changes to its worklog.
assertions: The execution context has a stable feature task ID
Unchanged baseline files are excluded
A baseline file changed again is reported as ambiguous
Only feature B activity is completed

evals.name: stale-activity-expiry
evals.prompt: Inspect a new task after an unrelated activity in the same workspace has been idle for nine hours.
evals.expected_output: Elapsed time starts from the new task and the stale activity is removed.
assertions: Activity is keyed by task identity
The nine-hour activity expires
No earliest-workspace fallback is used
Completion deletes only the active task

evals.name: validated-candidate-not-spec-ready
evals.prompt: Run to-spec with an architecture candidate whose status is validated and readiness is validated.
evals.expected_output: The candidate is not accepted as specification-ready without readiness ready-for-spec.
assertions: Validated status alone does not authorize to-spec
The missing readiness transition is named
No ready specification is produced
No production implementation is offered

evals.name: invalid-artifact-frontier
evals.prompt: Resolve a ticket frontier when the ready source spec omits verification seams and a ticket references an unknown AC ID.
evals.expected_output: Artifact validation fails closed and the frontier is empty.
assertions: The missing verification seam is an error
The unknown AC reference is an error
Frontier validation runs before ticket selection
The returned frontier is empty
